about:
# AutomaticRoleCheck

Lightweight approach for automatically accepting role check pop-ups.

[![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/v/448353?label=CurseForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/automatic-role-check) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/448353?label=downloads)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/automatic-role-check) [![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/jordinbrouwer/AutomaticRoleCheck?label=GitHub)](https://github.com/jordinbrouwer/AutomaticRoleCheck/releases/latest)

## Usage

Type `/arc` to open the options window. You can also open it from the game's settings: **AutomaticRoleCheck** > **Open AutomaticRoleCheck**.
Drag the grip in the bottom right corner to change the width and height of the window; right-click the grip to go back to the default size.
Every option shows a tooltip when you hover it. Most boxes have a `Reset` link that puts the settings of that box back to their defaults; click it twice to confirm.

### Enabled and My role

- `Enabled`: switches the addon on or off.
- `My role`: the `Tank`, `Healer` and `Damage` roles a role check gives you when you queue. Click a role to switch it on or off (not in combat).
- `Follow spec`: your roles follow your specialization.
- `Set in group`: also sets your role in your group, when you change it here or join a group (not in combat).

### When addon is enabled

- `Disable whilst AFK`: do not accept while you are AFK.
- `Disable once`: skip the next role check.
- `Disable once on login`: skip the first role check after you log in.
- `Disable once on role change`: skip the next role check after you change your role.

### What to accept and Only when

- `What to accept`: `Role checks`, `Role polls`, `Group invites` and `Group sign-ups`.
- `Only when`: `When I play a tank`, `When I play a healer`, `When I play damage`, and `Where`: `Everywhere`, `Group or instance` or `Instance only`.

### When it is accepted

The table has an `In combat` and an `Out of combat` column. The game doesn't let addons accept in combat, so in combat the popup waits and is accepted right after combat ends.

- `Accept for me`: accept the popup for you. Off: you click the popup yourself.
- `Hide the popup`: hide the game's popup while it waits or is accepted.
- `Play a sound` and `Sound`: play `Raid warning`, `Ready check`, `Quest complete`, `Auction bell` or `Whisper`.
- `Wait before accepting` (out of combat only): `No wait`, or 1, 2, 3 or 5 seconds to step in yourself.
- `Linked`: the `Out of combat` column follows the `In combat` column. `Separate`: each column is set by itself.

By default both columns accept for you, hide the popup and play the `Ready check` sound.

While the addon is on, the game's own ready-check sound is muted (also for normal ready checks), so only the sound you chose plays.

### When addon is disabled

- `/arc disable`: turn the addon off.
- `Enable once`: accept the next role check. `/arc enable once` does the same.

### Commands

Messages show as toasts at the top of the screen; click a toast to close it.

- `/arc`: open the options window.
- `/arc help`: show the commands.
- `/arc status`: show the status for the next role check.
- `/arc enable [once]`: switch on, or with `once` for the next check only.
- `/arc disable [once]`: switch off, or with `once` for the next check only.
- `/arc minimap [show|hide|toggle]`: show the minimap button, hide it, or switch between the two.

### Skipping next role check

For in-the-moment use, this is the fastest way to skip a single role check:
- Hold `Shift` while the role check appears, and only that upcoming check will be skipped.

If you prefer planning ahead, you can use `/arc disable once` (or `Disable once`) before the next role check appears.

### Minimap button

The check mark on the button is green when the addon is on, red when it is off, and amber while something waits for combat to end.
By default:

- `Left-click`: switch on or off.
- `Shift + Left-click`: hide the button.
- `Right-click`: open the options.

In the `Minimap button` box you choose what `Left-click`, `Right-click`, `Shift + Left-click` and `Shift + Right-click` do (`Switch on or off`, `Open options`, `Skip next check`, `Hide the button` or `Nothing`), and switch `Show button`, `Colour` (the status colour of the check mark) and `Lock` (no dragging around the minimap). The tooltip of the button lists your clicks.

## Screenshots

## Development

Please see [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/jordinbrouwer/AutomaticRoleCheck/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) for development checks and contribution guidance.

## Feedback

Please remember that I'm always working to improve the addon, so I'm interested in hearing directly from you about anything you want to share or ask. You can report this using the issues on GitHub.
When reporting bugs or unexpected behavior, include your addon version and an overview of your current options.

## Changelog

Please see the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/jordinbrouwer/AutomaticRoleCheck/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) for more information about recent changes.

### Fixed
- The header no longer cuts off the second line of its description when the window opens. ([cb56692](https://github.com/jordinbrouwer/AutomaticRoleCheck/commit/cb56692d1253f414e675ecc99bf91a1e138b9e46))

### Fixed
- The game's ready-check sound plays again for ready checks, Dungeon ready, Group Finder invites and role checks the addon leaves to you. ([0ea5422](https://github.com/jordinbrouwer/AutomaticRoleCheck/commit/0ea542288767991035a01afbec3261a9f19792cb))
- With Set in group on, role polls pick the role you chose instead of the one from your spec. ([7b13eec](https://github.com/jordinbrouwer/AutomaticRoleCheck/commit/7b13eec7be69123253fafed62ec5dd48f9d1acdd))
- When I play a tank, healer or damage follows the roles you chose under My role, not your spec. ([6adfc2c](https://github.com/jordinbrouwer/AutomaticRoleCheck/commit/6adfc2c82920ecc5df4f73bf3218bc3ac3bf4f55))
- The header description goes on over more lines instead of ending with ..., and the header grows with it. ([da20a50](https://github.com/jordinbrouwer/AutomaticRoleCheck/commit/da20a50e285efafec1dcbbf747fdc1a51e800dc9))

### Fixed
- Header text ends with ... and the window is no wider than its default width. ([23852d9](https://github.com/jordinbrouwer/AutomaticRoleCheck/commit/23852d986d304efd64e00511de82c768bc029c56))

### Added
- Added a new options window of its own, opened with `/arc`: a header with the logo, a thin scroll bar, its own tooltips and a hint about `/arc help` at the bottom. The game's settings page now has a button that opens it.
- Added resizing of the options window: drag the grip in the bottom right corner to change its width and height, right-click the grip to go back to the default size. The size is remembered.
- Added accepting in combat: the popup waits and is accepted right after combat ends, and the minimap button shows that something is waiting.
- Added the "When it is accepted" table with In combat and Out of combat columns: accept for me, hide the popup, play a sound, choose the sound, and wait before accepting (out of combat only). With "Linked" the Out of combat column follows the In combat column.
- Added "What to accept" (role checks, role polls, group invites, group sign-ups) and "Only when" (when I play a tank, healer or damage, and where: everywhere, group or instance, or instance only).
- Added the "My role" box: switch Tank, Healer and Damage on or off for the Group Finder, "Follow spec" to set the role from your specialization, and "Set in group" to also set your role in your group.
- Added a "Minimap button" box: show the button, colour the check mark by status, lock the button in place, and choose what Left-click, Right-click, Shift + Left-click and Shift + Right-click do.
- Added a "Reset" link to most option boxes that puts the settings of that box back to their defaults (click it twice).
- Added `/arc help`, which shows the commands as keys in a message that stays until you click it.
- Added a new logo, used for the addon icon, the options window, the messages and the minimap button.

### Changed
- Changed `/arc` to open the options window instead of listing the commands.
- Changed all messages to show as toasts at the top of the screen instead of lines in chat.
- Changed the minimap button: the check mark of the logo is green when the addon is on, red when it is off and amber while something waits for combat to end, and its tooltip lists the clicks as you set them.
- Changed what happens by default out of combat: the game's popup is hidden while it is accepted, and the Ready check sound plays when it has been accepted.
- Changed sounds: while the addon is on, the game's own ready-check sound is muted (also for normal ready checks), so only the sound you chose plays.
- Changed the code layout into separate folders for core, window, texts and pictures.

### Removed
- Removed `/arc options`; use `/arc` to open the options window.

### Added
- Added auto-accept support for the role poll popup.
- Added WoW Forever compatibility via interface version `16001`.

### Changed
- Updated specialization role detection to use `C_SpecializationInfo` on newer clients.
- Updated release and CurseForge publish scripts to handle multiple TOC files.
